structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Control of Crustacea, Finfish and Shellfish; Violations and Penalties

law.catch_line: State Health Commissioner to establish standards
law.text: The State Health Commissioner may establish and change standards, examinations, analyses and inspections which control the taking and marketing from a health standpoint, of crustacea, finfish or shellfish. He shall be the sole judge of whether or not such crustacea, finfish or shellfish are sanitary and fit for market.
